text: Very enjoyable pizza but definitely not 5 star amazing.  Great for the price and the pepperonis were delicious!

Foxtail is the best hangout spot in Santa Barbara!! They have so many games that you can come and play with your friends or family. Falah is the best bartender and will always make sure you are satisfied. I recommend the desert rose drink.

Friday, July 3, 2020: Chose the Rivergate Outback for lunch during the Phase 2 rollback due to the pandemic. Greeter wore a mask and required us to wear ours when not eating or while sitting at the table. Servers wore masks. Social distancing was practiced. 

First the disappointing part of our visit. Limited menu with DINNER prices. We struggled at first with staying, not expecting to pay $11.99 for a cheese burger for lunch when we had been accustomed to lunch specials pre-COVID. They currently have only one menu. Apologies were offered by several. Debated on whether to stay but did and were not disappointed with the quality of the food or the service. 

Brandon was our server. Very friendly. The food was fresh and cooked to order. I understand that Outback as to pay for the additions:changed as a result of COVID but may put a damper on my ability to eat out on a regular basis.

Stumbled upon this ramen joint and I'm so glad I did! The ramen is delicious!! I also order their pork bun--the pork was a little burnt. Anyways....nack to the ramen--the broth was amazing!!! You just have to come try this place yourself! You won't be disappointed!!!!

Beef short rib taco is amazing and teriyaki chicken is a close second. Also liked the spicy pork taco. Just stopped by on my way through St. Louis and very glad I did. In fact, I wish I could come back for dinner, but I'll be far sown the road. A big thanks to Sue for making recommendations to a first timer and setting me up for a great lunch!  I highly recommend this place!

Food: pepperoni and Nutella pizza. Pepperoni is always my go to and this place makes a pretty good one. Super thin crust. Not too much cheese and the sauce is amazing. The Nutella pizza was interesting. It was like kinda like crunchy crepes with layers of Nutella and marshmallow fluff in between. Maybe ours was alittle over done because some parts of it were really crispy and kinda hard to bite into but overall worth the try. Definitely wanna come back and try out some more of their pizzas.

This was SUCH a pleasant surprise! We were looking for a place to have brunch and stumble on this spot. From the outside it looks like a hole-in-the-wall, but once you get in you realized you've found a gem. It was packed, but the service was great and the food was excellent! We will definitely make it one of our go to places to eat when in the area. I look forward to trying their lunch and dinner menu item.

Walked in Sunday for brunch. Was told "due to the influx of reservations we had to sit at the bar". Which was fine but the restaurant stayed pretty quite with plenty of open tables. However there were so many bar stools you couldn't even slide in front to sit down. Then once you do, you are on top of your neighbor. The bar tender worked at a snails pace. Had to continue to ask for the basics. Salt/pepper, ketchup, water.. etc. the food was great! I would only go back if nothing else was open.

In the afternoon it seemed the wait staff was tired. Although I did like the ladies room decor I did not know that this places theme was based on sexual orientation. I figured Mary was the owner. 

Food was pretty basic and again wish that we had known via the Groupon we purchased it was more of s progressive place

I can't tell you anything about the pizza because I tried to order one at 8:30 on a Friday and they told me they closed at 7:30?! The guy blamed it on corona but it's Sept. 4th. I don't know if I'll try again another day, I just spent 40 minutes reading their reviews here and on google just to be thorough so, yeah I'm mad.

This place is super cute. The decor is beautiful and staff is super nice and helpful. The food was also delicious. Keep in mind that when you order, don't underestimate how much they give you. It was A LOT of food. And although it's all you can eat, there will be a $13 charge if you're wasting food. Well at least that's what the sign says. I ordered a lot but was able to finish it all and I ended up feeling like I was gonna throw up haha. The broth was decent, if I'm being honest. There wasn't much taste but I can't complain. So if you're looking for a hotpot experience for a good price, then this place is your best bet. Will def come back!
Definitely worth the drive. Pork fried rice, beef with chinese broccoli, general tsao chicken was all really good. Definitely will come back.

This is my second visit. The first time there were no tips or ribs, but I found out later that there were a lot of unexpected large orders. This time I was hoping to try the tips. I was glad they had them this time. My only issue is the 35 minutes I had to wait for my order. The taste of the tips will decide if I come back. Or maybe I will call my order in and wait about 15 mins before I leave my house. ‍ I would be more understanding if I had a special order, but I feel like it was just a basic order according to the menu and the type of establishment this is. Also, I was not impressed with the amount of time that I had to wait before someone even took my order. I was able to walk right up to the counter, but a few of the people working just stood there and looked at me for a few minutes before someone finally took my order. I am getting better at writing reviews on here as this is one of the first ones I have written.
G's Pizza is always official. The pies are always amazing, this was the first time I tried something other than I pie. The wrap was delicious I didn't love the vinaigrette, but overall satisfied.

Just ok. I wanted to order the scramble with hashbrowns but they said they couldn't do it without the eggs. I just wanted like a beef hash style, but I guess the eggs are already pre-made into their scrambles? Doesn't sound like it's fresh made to me. Either that or the chef's just lazy. I ended up ordering the Chili over rice Hawaii style, which was nothing like Hawaii. Canned chili tasted better.

"Still waiting..."

I posted the review below in October. Within a day or two, I received a reply from the restaurant telling me they would reach out directly to me to resolve my concerns. Almost 2 months later, I have yet to be contacted. I guess I shouldn't be surprised as this was very similar to my experience while having dinner. "Still waiting" was the theme of my dinner on 10/16 and now is the theme with any contact with the restaurant. This is disappointing as it appears their Yelp response was to give the appearance that they cared to anyone who read the review.

"I want to start by saying that I have been a huge fan of the Bartaco in Hyde Park Village since it opened. I am a resident of Hyde Park and I often have recommended it because the tacos are delicious and the service has always been fantastic. A manager would almost always stop by my table to ensure my experience was exemplary. Unfortunately, I am writing to inform you of a visit to Bartaco on Oct 16, 2020. It started when I was checking in at the hostess station. I approached and saw another customer ahead of me and a girl behind the counter scrolling through a tablet. I assumed she was looking for his name on the wait list. I stood there for about 2 minutes. Then another girl walked up and the first girl told her, "they haven't been helped." I then realized neither the guy ahead of me nor myself had been acknowledged at all. I dont know her name but the girl had blue hair and was not wearing the gingham shi

Was going to a movie downtown and Tiffin's was a close walk away from the theatre to get some dinner before the show. The restaurant is located where the old Sobeys used to be. It is quite stylish and has tons of seating! As soon as you open the doors, an amazing aroma hits you! They have quite an expansive menu with a variety of vegetarian and meat curries. Coupled with this are multiple choices of rice, toppings, naan, chai tea, etc. I wish I would have tried the chai! I ended up getting the butter chicken with garlic naan and coconut rice. Everything was so good! For $15, I was able to have two meals from the portion they gave. The butter chicken was milder which is what I like (I am a spice wimp). I wish I could talk to you about more things but my friend got the exact same thing, just saffron rice instead! The employees were very helpful, answered questions and were efficient. I will definitely be going back the next time I have an Indian food craving!

I went to Jolibee waited for 2 hours in line with Staff taking orders with ordering Restrictions in place only allowed to spend $60 dollars max then not to mention the Buckets of Chicken are expensive... I like Spicy Chicken but I would never buy Original Chicken again or buy the Filipino Spaghetti too Sweet however I would buy Mango peach pies they Delicious.

I usually don't leave a review but when I do it is usually when it is super good or super bad. I am glad to say One world market is one of the best value Japanese restaurant in Indy. I say value because the food is pretty standard, which means it won't be the best Japanese food you ever tasted. However, you won't feel like you wasted money and didn't get what you paid for like many other Japanese restaurant in Indy. If you crave for some sushi, this is the best go to place.
DO NOT GO HERE. I've been waiting in line for almost 30 minutes and haven't even ordered yet. Horrendously slow. This is not fast food. Fast food should never take this long.

I mean...I'm not going to sugar coat it. Absolutely the worst experience I have ever had with a restaurant. I placed an order to-go ahead of time, and they said it was going to be ready in 15-20 minutes. It takes me 25 minutes just to get to this location specifically. When I get in, there was no one there to help me. No hostess. No waiter. Nothing. So i had to wait even a little longer till I see someone I can ask. Even some waiters saw me standing there and just continued on about their business. Trash. A hostess finally attends to me and when I told her I had to-go she went to the back to check. Tell my why she gunna say it'll be ready to soon. Keep in mind I had to get to class soon too. I decided to wait and man...worst decision ever. It legit took another 20 minutes till my food is ready. Like what? And how is some of the food hot and some of it cold. It's like they cooked the eggs first, then made some pancakes and sausages 20 minutes after the eggs been just sitting there. Lucky I can't give this place 0 stars and report it to shut down. If I could, I would. This ihop is such a waste of space, let a real caring restaurant be opened here. Not another chain franchise with absolutely trash service. I vowed to never go here again. I would rather eat water than try and get food here again. Don't EVER go here. EVER.
Stupid policy won't let people sit inside (or even wait inside for our order) when every other restaurant in town does. It does let employees wear mask with valves.

Consistent. Friendly. Fast. I've been going to Rocco's for years. Their pizza is ok in my book. Not my personal favorite with the exception of the melanzano. 

Their Italian dishes are great. I love their veal but they don't always have it which can be frustrating b/c the menu days they make it Friday and Saturday. 

The lasagna is good. The chicken parm is good. The pasta tends to be a bit overcooked. 

The steaks are the best around here. The meat is actually seasoned, the rolls are fresh, and the meat o bread ratio is perfect.

They have lots of creative salads. 

Above al, their meatballs are ahe star of the show. I rider them by the tray for parties and events. 

Definitely a great place to eat out with the family or take out. 

One request: BRING BACK STUFFED EGGPLANT PIZZA BY THE SLICE ON FRIDAYS! 

G see y friends at Rocco's. And oh yeah tell em Big Texas sent you!
Very few restaurants In the US remind me of the amazing food in Italy but Bella Italia took us back.  Our family loved our dinner.  We can't wait to go back!

We had a great time!  Our server, Raven, was excellent. I've been watching reviews since the opening and We didn't experience any of the negatives.  Yeah the prices are high, but this was a special occasion we planned for. Food was as good as the other burger joints in STL. Service was friendly and prompt.

Heck yes! So good and compared to the bay really big serving and good prices. For $45 I got 3 clusters of snow crab, two sausages, two corns, and plenty of potatoes. The sauce was bomb and flavorful. I got the mix of all the sauces with I believe hot heat and some extra butter on the side. Please get the extra butter it's soooooooo good and you can save some for later. Ended up coming home after and caught a crab to use with the butter and it was delicious. I will see you again Krab Kings.

Prospero the manager was very attentive with my order! The entire staff gave me Outstanding service even on one of the busiest days of the year. Highly recommend Santa Barbara shellfish co.  Also thank you Sean for your quick response and your patience and help to my emails.  We had a great birthday dinner.
Really good drunken noodles. I ask for medium spice and it opened all the sinuses.. guess next time it's light spice

This place is my go to with my friends. We can eat, drink and be happy. They do not rush you out the door, they are attentive and knowledgeable on the menu. The only thing that make me unhappy is the changing of the menu. Guess my favorites are not everyone's favorites LOL!
Place has lost its charm since new management.  Atmosphere is lame, totally different crowd now

I stopped by this Caplinger's location yesterday. Though it's a bit tight, the staff did a great job of moving people through the line and getting the food out. 

I ordered the fish and shrimp with the chipotle slaw and red beans & rice. Food took awhile to come out but when it did it was nice and hot. Everything was tasty except the red beans & rice but thankfully David Caplinger took a moment to ask how my food was. When I mentioned the red beans & rice weren't very tasty, he immediately asked what I'd like instead. He replaced that side dish with piping, hot French fries! 

Great service and great food! Thanks David for taking the time to make customers feel welcomed and appreciated!

Had a wonderful dinner tonight. The spaghetti and Greek vinaigrette salad were phenomenal. My boyfriend had the veal and loved it. Family owned restaurant with staff who are all friendly and take great pride in what they do. 10/10! Definitely must try.
If you are brought up in India you won't like the food. Chef is confused about the flavors.

I'm tempted to give them 3 starts but I had good service so here we go.
Went in for my birthday dinner and I was surprised to get a birthday card signed by them.
Service is attentive, I ordered From the Sea dish, which came with two pieces of fish over a corn cake, some beans and roasted carrots and corn. Nice presentation but one piece of fish was over cooked and not very warm. I also had the Brussels as a side, that was good.
On to dessert I had matcha Pavlova - good but didn't taste much like green tea. The sorbet that came with it didn't have much taste either. So just an ok dessert.
Overall a good dinner but nothing fancy.
So updated they recently changed things to not even longer give side sauces and the flavor started to really take a hit. I would order from their other location in fishtown or try another store
Great food! Been coming here for months.  Everything on their menu is consistently well-made & always delicious!

My friends brought me here because I really love middle eastern food.
I had high expectations but was not that impressed overall. The food tasted good but I felt for the prices they charge for not very expensive ingredients, the portions should be much larger that they were, probably double.  We started with the beet and pecan dip.  It was very good but for $7.50 it was ok. We then had the Spinakopita which were spinach and cheese in phyllo dough. There were 4 bite size pieces for $9.00.  This is ridiculous.  We then ordered the falafel feast which was $36.00 which was absurd for tiny dishes of typical middle eastern street food.  We ordered another platter and all left not fulfilled. Even if this were half the price, I would have found it expensive. I guess they can get these prices here because of the lack of competition for middle eastern food.
This Panera bread location makes the best sandwiches. The Panera near my house does not make sandwiches as delicious as these. The little extra time to travel here is worth it . I LOVE IT

Tried the pastrami and found it to be delicious . So was the Matso ball soup and the pickle.  This is the first place where I have found those awesome pickles that remind me of my childhood. Bought a quart of pickles to go and have been back to buy 2 more quarts. Thank you Mr Pasrami .  Will be back.

I'm a fan of this healthy restaurant. The nachos are solid. There is layer after layer of goodness with brown rice and black beans layered in. 

The salads with their lemon dressing is delicious. My favorite is the Old Town Salad though the one with the grilled veggies is also very tasty.

The Vegan burger is delicious. I found it tastier than I expected.

The only skip it that I've ever ordered is the veggie tacos. This is such a letdown and not filling at all. The nachos are so much better.

Today was an example while we need to support small businesses vs chains. My reservation was at 3:45p. They didn't want to seat me until the whole part (+1) was there. I said my reservation was at 3:45p and I'm ready to eat. Dawn the manager was slightly rude and needed to know if I was going to be here a hour or three hours. Does it matter if I'm ordering and paying???

My favorite Indy grocery store bar none.  I live clear across town, but I make it a point to venture here as often as I can.

Saraga is a large international grocery store featuring exceptionally diverse staff, customers, food, and ingredients.  The aisles are logically organized by culture, region, and cuisine - e.g. Mexican, Filipino, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Indian, Vietnamese, European, African, and so on.  The produce section is just as diverse, and the fish counter hosts live fish that the staff will filet for you.  Prices are cheap if you're used to shopping at chain grocery stores, and comparable to other international / Asian markets in Indy.  There's a quality Mexican bakery at the front of the store that is ridiculously cheap, as well as a small taqueria and a small Chinese eatery (featuring mostly Cantonese and street food staples) elsewhere in the store.

You may feel intimidated by Saraga if you're not used to shopping at international or Asian markets.  While staff here are kind, they often are not so in the "Hey there, how ya doin?!" style you'd expect in a Western chain grocery store.  While the store is clean, it isn't staged like a Western chain grocery store, so it may appear a little more disheveled than you're used to.

I encourage you to push through any initial awkwardness and just have fun.  Bring a friend if it helps.  Pick up some ingredients you've inevitably never heard of.  Ask questions at the fish counter.  Explore.  Source ingredients for th

This is one of the best quick breakfast spots in Reno. Not snooty, not overrated, and has straight forward delicious food and coffee. They have fresh bagels to go as well for those days you want to stay in for breakfast. Overall full of character and originality.

Only place open for lunch and they know it by that side of the river...very slow service...no check in on food which had errors to the order...waitress forgot my ask of a side salad...and took forever w lemons...pretty disappointing...burger was good and show was the shrimp appetizer

I found Harpoon Harry's Crab House to be the perfect venue to host a surprise 60th birthday party I threw for my wife. The restaurant manager (Eric) was fantastic to work with. He and his crew went out of their way to ensure all of our requests were satisfied.

Despite a relatively large group (44 guests), everyone commented on how their service was impeccable and how the food was delectable too. Eric also provided a feeling of privacy with the creative use of partitions. I definitely rate our experience as being 5 stars!!! Thank you for helping make my wife's celebration super special!!

Finally made it in and mannn does it live up to the hype! 

The service was good. We sat on the patio because it was a nice night and, well, covid. The restaurant followed the rules when it comes to masks and spacing. I was a little grossed out the server bringing a stack of share plates that all happened to be dirty. It happens.

The food was great! We got:
Alcachofas Fritas- Crispy artichokes with romesco sauce and shaved Manchego cheese. These were really good! I loved the Romesco sauce!

Bacon-Wrapped Dates - MUST ORDER - these were what dreams are made of! Also pretty self explanatory, just order if you know what is good for yourself..

Queso De Cabra al Horno - MUST ORDER - goat cheese in a tomato sauce served with garlic bread.  This dish is one of my favorites in STL and worth a trip to BARcelona for.

Patatas Bravas - Really Good - roasted potatoes covered in tomato and spicy sauces. 

Roasted Brussels Sprouts - Good - roasted with pine nuts. 

Meatballs - Very Good - not normally a meatball person but these were flavorful and had the perfect combination of sauce and cheese to balance out the dish.

I had the Lechon and pancit.  The lechon was nice and crunchy and the pancit was good also.  I wanted to try some lumpia and bbq, but I knew I wouldn't be able to finishing it all.  I will return and try chicken adobo as well as the bbq and lumpia.

We stopped here for breakfast on Saturday morning. There was a short wait because the dining area is pretty small. It's certainly a meat and three type place. Some specials were posted by the kitchen and we received a menu when we were seated.  The menu had plenty of options so I ordered the steak biscuits which came with some home fries and a bowl of gravy. I also added a side of tomatoes. Nick ordered the Early Bird Special which had eggs, meat (he chose sausage), biscuits and gravy and hash browns. He substituted hash brown casserole (listed on the specials board) for the hash browns.  Our food arrived quickly. I was a little disappointed to see that my steak was breaded, like country fried steak. But both pieces were identical, so I knew they had been frozen out of a bag. They tasted fine, I was just expecting real steak I guess.  If you put enough gravy on anything it is going to taste good, though. The home fries were on the greasy/flimsy side, but tasted fine. The best part of our meals was Nick's hash brown casserole. It was just like Cracker Barrel's.  

We liked the atmosphere and the food, so we will go back.  I'd love to try their lunch menu, too.

There was no social distancing and all of the employees had a mask that didn't cover their noses. But, they were very quick to disinfect and clear off tables. I watched the busser also wipe down the seats really well.
Do not fucking go here the manager/ owner is sooo fucking rude to the workers / customers she does not know how to serve at ALLL!!

Today was our first time here.  
Food: Amazing!  We had a variety of apps, entrees and drinks.  Everyone was delicious.  Worth the wait...to some degree
Wait: We waited over 30 mins for our appetizers to arrive.  We understood it's a "scratch kitchen" so we anticipated some of the wait.   However, even after we got our apps, it took about 45 mins to get our entree.   
Service:  Impeccable.  Honestly, the service (and the food) made up for the wait.   Our server, Elijah, is the epitome of a 5-star server.  His recommendations were spot on. He was incredibly friendly and personable.  Even though it was busy, he didn't forget about us.  It mattered to him that we were taken care of.  Thank you, Elijah!
Came in after the shutdown was lifted and had a couple drinks at the upstairs patio! Beautiful spot to enjoy the scenery. Kasie was a great bartender and a pleasure to talk to!

I was pretty excited about this place. It is the newest addition to the Graduate Hospital area (and I also live like 4 blocks away). They have a packed downstairs as well as an upstairs area that is well decorated and feels like a hip home. It's still fairly new, but if you want to come here - you should definitely make reservations. The reason I gave this place 2 stars is mainly because of the food. I ordered a burrito the first time, which was relatively cheap (on the order of 10 dollars), but it was just very bland and uninspired. The drinks were good (we got a pitcher of their house margarita), but the food just weighed the whole experience down. Overall, I'm excited that we have a new mexican spot close by, but hopefully their menu will improve as they get settled.

Hidden gem.  We ordered spinach noodles, with egg & tomato sauce, minced pork sauce & hot chilli oil; chive dumplings, sour & spicy soup; and diced pancake stew in lamp soup.

Ordering was easy over the phone and ready for pickup in 30 mins.

Diced pancake stew in lamp soup was available on Thursday also.  We added sour & spicy soup to the diced pancake stew to liven the taste.

Yum yum yum! I ordered the Raclette & Gouda Grilled Cheese and it was amazing! So sweet and savory. I am not big on too sweet and this was just the right amount of flavors to even it all out. The egg on top just added an extra layer of deliciousness mellowing out the stronger flavors. I definitely felt like it was worth the price and I will be ordering it again!

For desert we had the Banana Brioche Cinnamon Roll With Butterscotch Cream Cheese Icing. And Oh. My. God. The icing was to die for! It was rich and creamy. Perfect for those with a sweet tooth. We were so stuffed but could hardly keep our forks down! Will be back for sure.

Order take out from here about 2 weeks ago ( month of September) 
And I thought it was good , judging only on the seafood boil fiery/garlic mix we had.
We'll probably order it again to go... it was good to us.

the food is trash worst jamaican food in the city 
don't waste your time and money on this garbage.. i paid $14 for this

I like their food.  They're pretty good at that.

I also like getting what I ordered.  They're not good at that.

Today was the 5th straight time they've screwed up my to-go order.  The cashier entered the correct burger, so this was on the kitchen.

Maybe next time I'll order "surprise me" -- because that's what I'm getting anyway.  If there is a next time.

Good food and amazing service

The young lady behind the counter did it all!  Cooked the food, answered the phone, ran the cash register and did it all with a pleasant attitude 

The pulled pork was too salty but the Huli Huli chicken was fantastic. 

The pasta salad was ok. Seemed like it was missing something.

I had been hearing about ITA101 from a few friends as the hot and newer legit Italian eatery in South Jersey. I am not sure how to pronounce ITA101, is Ita1010 to I-T-A101? Does it stand for a college course in Italain? I guess I should have asked. However it is pronounced, we drove  up to Medford on a nice October evening after calling ahead for seating availability. We were told we could have a table outside but inside was full until 9:00 PM. That was fine with us as it was nice enough weather and we were armed with sweaters and light jackets.

ITA101 is located right on Main St. in Medford. Street parking is easy to come by. The restaurant space itself looked very nice and casual. It is smaller, and probably only holds 30-40 patrons. As mentioned above we chose to dine outside to snag a table and there were several nice tables right beside the restaurant. ITA101 is BYOB which is great. ITA101 serves a smaller and limited, rotating menu with fresh, local ingredients in a farm to table fashion. The Chef Kevin Maher spent 14 years in Italy honing his craft.

What we ordered;

Braciole di Maiale con Fungi, Polenta, Gorgonzola -pork chops with chanterelle mushrooms, polenta, gorgonzola.

Gramigna di Seppia Nera con Capesante, Gamberi e Rombo-black ink gramigna, scallop, shrimp, fluke, sungold tomato sauce 

The pork chop was ordered off the weekend Regional menu. This dish was outstanding and the pork was tender and juicy. The polenta was done just right and there were some app

I didn't expect there to be a great Thai spot in Indy but this place hits the spot. The restaurant itself is beautiful and spacious. There is a pretty wine display along one of the walls. We got the chicken satay, spring rolls, pad thai with chicken, and penang curry with beef. All were solid. If I went back, I'd choose chicken as my protein for my entrees. Beef was a bit tougher than I enjoy.

Pandemic or not, the steak house at the Atlantis is the best restaurant I have been to in  years.  My husband had the prime rib and I had the blackened king salmon. Not only was the food fantastic but the service was impeccable.  Our server's name was Allan, and he was very professional yet friendly and just outstanding in every. The whole wait staff incomparable. I highly recommend dinner here.
Early 2021. They will only allow 2 beers per hour. So, you can play but don't plan on a night out. As a local, they need us but we won't be back for a long time when we can have fun other places.
Food is like the best home made meals I remember from my youth. The attentive staff are always friendly and welcoming. Hodaks is a St. Louis treasure! Love this special place.

Well now is now the food that has everybody on spcial media growing crazy, right next to tacos. Raijin has the most amazing authentic ramen I have had in Arizona yet, hands down! Be sure to get it extra spicy if you are feeling brave, especially with ths pork broth!
I love their corn chowder and kale avo ranch salad!! Delicious. Crave it. Great sandwiches as well.

This is like my 3rd time here but the 3rd visit was the best ! Jason shotts was super friendly he bought my friends and I a drink during happy hour for completing our program in school and we got 2 drinks for happy hour he came around  so much to check up on us make sure everything was good with us he was super friendly and made our visit here just extra special will definitely be coming back here often !

Food- Excellent super fresh ingredients. Always appreciate a decently priced and filling vegetarian meal.

Atmosphere- Cute and quaint. Not for large parties because theres only a couple two tops but great for a quick bite or takeout.

Service- Really friendly and responsive staff
So good! My friend and I both got the Nutty Bowl and were more than satisfied. The bowls had great taste and were very enjoyable and filling. Highly recommend!
Awesome vibes and great coffee! Fast and friendly service. 19th century Lutheran church with a very neat history. Will be back ASAP.

We were in town visiting the Nashville area and  found Pomodoro East when researching Yelp ratings and reviews. This restaurant is nestled in a neighborhood community and am glad we made the choice to eat here. My husband and I sat in the bar area and JJ, the bar manager, was our server. She was the best. She had a great personality and was full energy. She made good recommendations and made tasty cocktails. We split a Caesar salad and my husband had pizza and I had the bolognese lasagna. Both were outstanding. The bread that was served with oil and balsamic vinegar was also very good. 

Loved the restaurant and the ambiance was great. Glad we came across this gem while we were visiting!

A Po Boy is something you must have when you go to New Orleans and Johnny's won't let you down. This is a cash only establishment however! It's not cheap food but it's quality food with a big menu that will take some time to take to your table if you order something that takes time to fry or cook fresh (we got both crab cake and shrimp po boys). My daughter tried the muffuletta here and enjoyed it as well! I liked that they had a delicious mimosa! The staff is nice and the seating is somewhat limited so be aware of that at peak times.
Doesn't look like much but it's delicious! The drinks and the fried green tomatoes are enough to come back again and again! It's good for groups and it's a long wait; but it's definitely worth it.

I love this place! Every time I come to the mall i absolutely have to get this snack. Everything is fresh and is customized to the customer. I have never had to wait very long and they are always in stock. Keep up the great work!
The food here was good and bad the sushi were eh but the teriyaki chicken was amazing. Sadly the sushi wasn't too good but the people here were very nice here.

I was there twice, and while the food was good, the services was terrible. I went there a third time and while I was waiting, the people leaving were complaining about the service, so I left and have never returned.

Amazing, authentic, and fresh Mexican cuisine!!!  The portions, and flavors are unmatched in the Reno area!!!  Friendly and refreshing staff.  I have become a regular, and they treat myself, and friends as if we are family!  I am a picky eater, and they have always accommodated my little quirks.  The menu is vast, and varied.    Definitely worth the visit, and price!!!

We chose this little spot to try this morning for our Saturday breakfast. The staff was super friendly and it was impressively clean! (though one of the hand sanitizer dispensers was empty) I chose the skinny omelette. It was tasty, but a little too much with the whole garlic cloves in there, so I had to pick those out. All in all it was a good meal.

Our go to! The pizza dough, the subs, hot wings, fries, salads, mozzarella sticks and pretty much everything else is really good. Prices are reasonable, food is always on time and warm and they never messed up our order. Would definitely recommend over any pizza chain.
My go to whenever i'm craving Tom Ka Ga and Pad Thai which is pretty much every week. Generous portions and great service.
Holy smokes their polenta and sausage on the side. So good, it smelled amazing too. It was so savory and flavorful. 10/10 recommend.

Been here a couple times now and has always been a home run. Last time here we got carry out. Half cheese Louise and half pomodoro. It was delicious and had lots of cheese! Had it the next day as leftovers and was just as good. 

Only reason for the four stars is their ranch isn't very good. I'm someone who dips their pizza in ranch so having a tasty homemade ranch is a huge plus for me.
Staff was great and accommodating, but just a lot of confusion needs better management. I hope they can improve.

I would frequent this location when it was 'Goat Hollow', so I finally made time to check the reincarnation of the space as 'Mount Airy Taproom'!

The space has been made over into a classic brew pub which I really like.  There are high top tables; low tables and a long bar to or seating options.  I decided to sit at the bar and ask questions of the bartender!  

I like the draft options which had a good range of pilsners; stouts and ipas!  The bartender was super friendly and knowledgeable and after a good education on Mussels...I went to other that dish!  It was a good call because they were good!  

I like the vibe and energy of the place and I would return to check out the rotating draft lift and more food items!

Chicken is so flaky and good. Went on a slower morning we got our food relatively fast. I would definitely recommend the mac n cheese and the 3 piece dark meat fried chicken. I would not, however, recommend the candied yams (a little too much cinnamon, kind of tasted like a scented candle) but everything else about this place is awesome!!

Just moved to the area and was looking for a Chinese option. This was a "hail mary" that turned out for the best. Crispy dish (General Tso) was good and orange and garlic chicken were also good . Portions and prices went hand in hand. Quality food at a decent price

We were on a short trip to Wilmington, DE with the kiddos for a quick getaway. Our suite had a kitchen. We didn't want to cook since we were on a trip. We came upon vPho while searching for take-out spots. I'm sure the ratings speak for themselves in the community. As a native NYer, we have higher standards with food. We're naturally spoiled by our city from all walks of life and cuisines. Personally, I haven't come across any Vietnamese spots in the South that resemble NYC. I'm not sure, if it's the variation in cooking or we're just pretty spoiled. Our take-out might had fell short compared to the raving reviews from other customers. 

We ordered the following:

Grilled Pork Chop with Vermicelli (Bun Thit Nuong): pork chop pieces tasted tough. Mine didn't come with any pickled radish or carrots, bean sprouts, etc. Only cucumbers and lettuce. Aside from the meat, it would had been a comfort dish for a hot day.
Grilled Pork Chop (Com Suon): pieces were thin and tough, particularly for our kiddos. 
Beef Cubes with Rice (Com Bo Luc Lac): the seasoning is different from what we're used to coming from NYC. We're used to a thicker sauce that adds more depth and flavor. It's interesting that a lot of familiar dishes taste different depending which part or where you're traveling to. 

It was also brought to my attention that vPho uses genuine beef bones in their broth and no MSG in their food. I was under the impression that most Vietnamese restaurants in the South substitute their

Oak and Ola you are most certainly remarkable, I had a wonderful experience here today. Glad we stumbled in here. The menu is really amazing, lots of great choices, I had to go with Pommes Frites, and it was great. Workers are very welcoming. They're accommodating, respectful and always on their game. Oak and Ola is great.
Dope spot to get to know people are bring along friends and family. Even during this pandemic. Great customer service and great drinks!!

I had the most amazing experience and food at farmhaus! They are really doing a beautiful job keeping quality as a top priority. I had the halibut and it was fantastic! The waitress was very attentive. And the chef even came out from the kitchen to make sure everything was to our satisfaction. If you want good food and good service give them a try.
Had a chorizo burrito delivered just now.  It was cold right through, which means that it is old.   I had to throw it away as I couldn't trust it. Don't eat here!

We visited this awesome spot on 8/21.  This was our first trip out since the pandemic began In March.  The staff all or face mask and the servers also wore face shields.  The seating and tables were spaced out by California safety guidelines.  We shared with our server Ahna that we had just got married and were celebrating our "mini-moon" since we couldn't go to Italy for our honeymoon.  She was super sweet and was happy to make our visit with them special.  We asked he for recommendations and she was very informative about the food and drink menu.  We ordered everything she suggested.

We ordered the ponzu scallops as our starter.  DELICIOUS!  I would recommend this highly. 

I ordered the USDA Prime Top Sirloin with mashed potatoes asparagus.  I ordered my steak medium rare.   My steak was cooked perfectly and was juicy with lots of flavor.  

My new husband ordered the Chipotle Blackened Swordfish.  I'm sure it was delicious because he ate everything on the plate before I had a chance to ask for taste.

We both had the captain mai tais as Ahna recommended.  We ended up ordering 5.  They were refreshing and smooth to drink. 

As a special surprise they gave us a complimentary desert.  We ordered the chocolate lava cake with vanilla ice cream.  My husband is not a sweets guy and we both LOVED IT.  We happily finished it.  

Thank you again to Ahna and the rest of the staff at the Bluewater Grill for making our first dinner on our Mini-Moon so memorable and special.
My son's favorite spot for sushi since he was three years old... that was seven years ago

We used to get take outs or eat here on regular basis, because it's convenient location based on where we live.  I called to order a take out order after I took my little daughter to the doctor last night.  They didn't have my order, and I realized I called the wrong restaurant, which is obviously my fault.  I tried to place an order here, because I explained I can't go across town with a sick child and want to order here.  The guy up front indicated that he needs to call the other place first.  After some loud discussions in the back of the restaurant with a woman (who may be the owner), he again told me to just go to the other restaurant to pick it up.  Again, I explained I can't go across town for a take out order with a sick child.  I tried to place an order there, again the young guy there is very hesitant and said it will "take a while".  I just told him don't worry about it if you don't want our business.

An hour after I got home, the other Vietnamese restaurant called and asked why we didn't pick up or call.  Obviously, this place never called them even though he volunteered to.

The service here is not professional.  The food is so so.  I don't need to understand Vietnames to know the woman in the back is being rude.

To be honest, I'm surprised that there are bad reviews of China King.  I've had their food at least six times now, and only found one offering to be less than great.  

So far I've had: crab rangoon, steamed dumplings, spring rolls, Kung Pao chicken, deluxe Lo Mein, General Tso's chicken, Szechaun style pork, sweet and sour chicken, pepper steak, and Moo Shu Pork.  The only disappointment among the list were the spring rolls.  They weren't as light & crispy as expected, and I'd probably skip them in the future.  

But, everything else has been sensational.  I've ordered in-store for carryout/take home once, had food delivered all other times.  Food was hot and fresh each time it was delivered, and within the quoted timeframe.  All the food is flavorful, fresh, and hot.  It's far and away the best Chinese (or Americanized/New York style Chinese) that I've found in the Largo area.  The Lo Mein, Moo Shu pork, and General Tso's chicken have been repeat orders, as well as the crab rangoon and steamed dumplings.  

Aside from excellent food, the people who run the business are attentive to detail.  Request extra hoisin sauce for the Moo Shu pork?  Check.  Asked for medium spicy General Tso's?  Check.  Hot mustard packets thrown in?  Check.  They haven't missed a beat with any special requests.  

Note that the sweet and sour chicken is just fried tempura chicken with sauce, but no vegetables.  And even dishes marked "hot" or "spicy" are very tame.  But as noted, they will add heat

First time ordering take out tonight and it was really good! Food was fresh, sushi was delicious and hibachi was yummy. 

We did order the rock shrimp and it was a little soggy but I'm willing to bet it's better eating in instead of take out. 

Highly recommend giving it a try. It's a nice little local spot and I'm happy they deliver

To cover the 2 stars, I'll say the food and waitress was good. Unfortunately, there was a roach on the wall next to our table and it smelled like feces every time someone came in or out of the bathroom. This place has a lot of potential.

I've heard about Pepperoni Ray's and have waited months to try it. I finally got a chance to order and omgee, I wish I would've tried it when I first heard about it. I ordered the cheesy bread and pizza. The cheesy bread had jalapeños in it. I don't even it jalapeños but I sure did that day! Page pizza is kept nice and warm until you arrive. My Mister ordered the wings and said he will continue to order them every time we go to Pepperoni Ray's. Don't miss out on this one.

My wife and I found ourselves here after church ended abruptly (for us at least) after we got into a spat over our taxes. We thought that this American Eatery might heal the hurt I caused for

I was having some stomach issues, and needed to "spray in the worst way" as my ex used to say. My blockage issues led me to the green lime pork chili and a coffee (a sure-fire combination for some brown flame) My wife ordered the 50/50 burger and a Diet Coke.  The DC came in a can...that's right a can (more on that later).  

The food came and while my wife said the burger was tasty, but the fries "lacked identity". I criticized her for this comment. I snuck a few when she went outside to call her bookie and I have to admit, they did lack identity. 
As a matter of fact, the whole place did. For example take the daily special (see picture). Impossible burger-cheddar, house pickles and thousand island....what is impossible about that? If you are going to call something impossible it should be too hot to eat, too big to eat or too nasty to handle. This seems to be a pretty regular burger combo. Whatever, I'm over it. 

The place is clean and the bathroom pristine. That's right, I finally had a BM! After I returned from blowing spackle I found the check to see that we were charged 3.00 for the canned Diet Coke! They must get their Diet Coke from the same place that Disney does! 

3 stars I guess the identity is a clean place with slightly above average food that charges 3 dollars for cans o

Stopped in late on a Saturday afternoon. Pleasant cafe with a little bit of an eclectic arthouse vibe. Small selection of beer and spirits. Menu was cafe staples sandwiches, breakfasts, soup, snacky sweets. Service was fast and pleasant. Certainly a place to visit!

Recently went to Franco's for the first time, loved the friendly service, Caribbean iced-tea, and appetizers (calamari and garlic knots). However when it came to the entrée, buffalo chicken pizza, I was disappointed. The chicken was great and not too too hot, but our pizza had what seemed to be american cheese slices melted on top. Might come back to try other items on the menu, but not the best first impression.
I like the chicken Tika masala here. Friendly and clean place with good prices. Be sure to order the garlic naan!
Super good sushi, a little on the pricey side but I've never been disappointed in my dining experiences there. Sometimes the wait can be a little long but the foods always worth it.

Satellite's success is a stellar reflection of owner Drew Cuddy. In September 2018, I enrolled in the WSET (Wine & Spirit Education Trust) Level 2 course hosted by Satellite. Although I was the oldest person in the class (by 30 years), and I had no prior experience in the wine industry, Drew welcomed me. Satellite facilitated a challenging WSET class as well as tasty, gorgeous, nutritional lunches. (I don't usually eat lunch but I gobbled every bite.) In the end, I passed Level 2 with merit, which earned me a certificate and a lapel pin from the UK. Unfortunately, I lost my cherished pin. Two years later, I emailed Drew to inquire about a replacement. As busy as he is, Drew responded within an hour. He told me how I could receive a replacement pin from the UK. Amazing. Right? Obviously, Drew is a warm and conscientious gentleman. And a savvy businessman. That's why Satellite will find continued success in a competitive Santa Barbara restaurant/wine bar venue.

Employees were friendly and helpful.  The young lady working the register explained there was no lettuce because of a shortage. And we appreciated that. 

Manager was hanging outside smoking a cigarette. When he was inside he was loud and rude to his employees calling one of them a loser. 

Sad that the chicken sandwich is now a pattie rather than a full chicken breast.
It's located on the Riverwalk.  Interior has a nice rustic chic vibe.  The food was so delicious and the bourbon list was great!  Must try!!

We've ordered pick up a few times since in house dining has stopped and it has been great each time. Friendly over the phone service while taking orders, and everything is packaged well to maintain its temp and labeled. The fries are delicious, the sandwiches have all been great and they have a lot of options to choose from. Cant wait till we can sit on their patio and enjoy the music while eating their food

What an amazing experience!  The food and wine selection was great.  The service we received from Audrey was outstanding.   The linguini with seafood, the chicken parmigiana,  and the fried ravioli appetizer were delicious.   The Gooey Butter Cake was the perfect way to end our meal.  

We will definitely visit again when in St. Louis.

Been coming here for years (even when they had a location out in Chesterfield), particularly before games.  Nice atmosphere although could use some cleaning.  The Caesar salad is the best anywhere!  Classic old bar atmosphere.

Great chicken, fried to perfection.  Coop's Fury is pretty hot, habanero added to their original Nashville hot.   I've had hotter, but this was a good balance of flavors.  Had the dirty bird sandwich.  Two tenders, pimento cheese, and their awesome house sauce. It's probably mayonnaise based, I'm writing a yelp review.   Ugh.

While at Perkins at 706 N. Lansdowne Ave, Drexel Hill PA 19026 we were waiting for our drinks with my son when a mouse came running from under one of the booth running over my son feet then disappeared under another booth. We told the waiter when he returned with our drinks and asked to be moved to another table, I also asked for the manager and told her they need an exterminator, she replied with I'm sorry not sure if we are going to eat there again.

This was a random stop on our way through town. We try to always steer toward local restaurants, even when just passing through on travels. Oscars was a quaint little restaurant in the center of downtown near Music City. The quality and taste of the food were a steal for the price! My boyfriend and I wanted a place to sit down and have a meal to get out of the car on our 13 hour drive. The staff was friendly and allowed us to dine in even though it was 30 minutes prior to closing. We had one of the daily specials, it included a crunchy shredded beef taco, 2 rolled beef tacos, a bean tostada and a drink for $6.75!! We also tried the carne asada torta, the meat to bread ratio was perfect. I would highly recommend Oscars. If we lived in town, this place would be on our routine rotation for dining out choices. Appropriate COVID practices are in place and being observed.

I'm so glad Boise's good scene is growing with the array of flavorful options at Food Land Market. This place doubles as a market and a restaurant/cafe. The shelves are fully stocked with an array of various Turkish, Mediterranean, and other European goods and sundries. They've got Turkish delights, candies, biscuits, olives coffees and so much more. 

The real treat, though, is the array of breakfast and lunch options. When I went recently, I was greeted by the friendly owners who totally sold me on the falafel plate. My eyes feasted as the owner placed the plate in front of me. Everything looked delicious, and, better yet, everything was so flavorful.

The falafels were crisp, crunchy and chewy; they were the perfect balance of each aspect. Each was packed with a blend of slightly tangy flavors that were further accented by the sour sauce and the yogurt-dill sauce. Taken together with the hummus, this dish vanished quite quickly as I ravenously chomped it down. 

I cannot wait to return! Finally, a good Mediterranean market with flavorful dining options and exceptional service.
Fantastic breakfast.  French toast is not the "normal" French toast.  It is a must try!!  We will definitely go back when in Clearwater.

Not bad for an AYCE hotpot place. Only thing is that the restaurant name implies this would be Japanese style shabu shabu spot, but honestly this is a Chinese hotpot place. Their broths are pretty standard (their tom yum broth was surprisingly good). I liked how its BYOB and how quick their service was considering it looked like one person was running all the orders and bussing the tables. I also liked how everything in the sauce station was individually packaged into mini cups. The guy at the front desk had trouble taking our forehead temperatures so he eventually just took it using our wrists. We mostly ate their beef and their fishballs. Really can't go wrong with those things. The only thing we probably didn't like was that when we ordered 2 orders of the udon, they gave us way too much (enough for 4 people). They give a lot when you order any veggies or noodle. We got pretty full early on because of this.
Best tacos we've ever eaten!  They need to bring them to Scottsdale. Super nice owners. Have already been there twice. Even reheated taste so good!  Well done.

I am So SHOCKED at the reviews on here. May the lunch is better but breakfast was horrible. Boxed eggs, a waffle that was hard enough to be a waffle cone and food that looked like it came out the microwave. And to add the place was absolutely disgustingly filthy. I could never.

I've been a big fan of The Emerson for a while now. I'm basically a Drag Brunch groupie, but that's for another time... Came here to give The Emerson crew some love in the time of COVID. I'm pretty particular about which establishments I will visit and I have to say, I felt super comfortable with my visit to The Emerson last Friday. The cocktails are delicious - now, always, forever - that's a given. The atmosphere is super lovely -  Tyler has done such a great job with the decor and the new patio section outside is really delightful. Staff is always wonderful and this last visit was no exception. Everyone was masked, friendly, and happy to be there. It was a Z Bar Pop Up when we were there and it was so awesome to share the love with another bar that is unable to be open because they don't serve food. Oh! And the food! We shared a Margherita pizza loaded with the biggest, freshest basil I've ever seen. I think of The Emerson as a bar that happens to have food (the cocktails is really where this place shines), but that pizza was really great. Support this spot! Be kind to your servers.

I don't think I am able to put my meal into words. This restaurant deserves fame and worship because it was among my top five dining experiences I've ever had. I had never had Kanafeh before and truth be told I was a little weirded out by rosewater, but boy was I completely blown away by this delicate dessert. The entirety of our meal was punctuated by delicious morsels that we decided we needed to add to our already massive appetizer kingdom. The best of were the tabouleh which was so fresh and lemony, the kibbeh hit the spot in terms of a little meat bite. And then the baba ganoush was one of my favorites as well. 

The ambiance and wait staff were impeccable! The restaurant was packed yet somehow incredibly sound proofed well because the deafening roar typical of restaurants where people are packed in like sardines was completely absent. Amazing place and amazing food, recommend to all those who want their tastebuds dazzled!

Delicious!! Wow oh wow! We were craving some Mexican while staying here at The Bellevue and luckily Jose Pistola's is doing takeout at just a short walk away. The salmon and chicken tinga tacos were amazing and their guac has so much flavor! I don't think I've had this good or Mexican food outside of California/New Mexico. We had friendly service as well. Definitely support this authentic Mexican spot! You won't be sorry! Next time we're back in Philly, we will be back!

Ordered for pick up, they will call when your order is ready. Also, prior to entering you need to call to advise you are outside. Don't forget your mask! Got the Mongolian beef, wontons and egg rolls. Everything tasted so good! Definitely ordering again.
Did not have our reservation on file. I've had better trout. The southern greens were awesome!

I'm new to the STL style pizza, but loving it. I am a fan of anything meat on a pizza. The anti-veggie pizza is perfect! Placing our order online and then running in for pick-up was very easy. The best part is they also sell Ted-Drews custard. Looking forward to our next family pizza night.
Very good.  Did not try to hurry us out. Server was very busy but we did not mind.  Would definitely return. I think a reservation is a plus.

I absolutely love this place. I hadn't been in a while...but was looking for somewhere close to home and quick that we could go...eat good, no sit on a patio...THIS IS A GO-TO!!

They have made some updates in light of COVID as far as protection, cleanliness and social distancing which is very much appreciated!  You order in side and go out to the patio to wait for them to bring your food out.

The food is awesome and prepared to perfection! I had the Grilled Cheese and my sister had the French Toast...both were surprisingly really good!!! I also had the local Momo's coffee...and in my opinion...it's better than Starbucks!! 

I did have a chocolate chip cookie (crunchy around the edges and soft in the middle like I like it)...but no pic bc I literally ate it so fast

Great service great food great atmosphere. Everything we got tasted fresh. We had the shrimp tacos which were completely awesome. The fish and chips....wow with the apple slaw. We had clam chowder omg fire.... and then we had mango tango great bit of sushi roll. We will be back.

I actually think that this might be my new favorite restaurant. It was absolutely fantastic. First, the design is beautiful, with greenery and wicker lanterns hanging down from the ceiling, a tiled bar in the center of the restaurant to set a fun vibe, dim lighting, and dance music. The energy was high.

The menu was fantastic as well, with photos that made each dish look absolutely amazing. I also loved how the menu has unique items (and a slight Spanish flair) with octopus, paella, ceviches and more. Right off the bat, you get free chips and salsa, but I definitely recommend getting the queso or guac too. We started with the queso and it was probably my favorite queso that I've had. SO GOOD.

I then went for the shrimp fajitas, which is enough food for two people or amazing leftovers the next day. I loved the shrimp, as well as the guac and sides that came with it all. Mmm. 

Be aware that people/tables didn't really feel socially distant at all, so maybe get takeout or come when it's warm out and you can sit on their great patio.

Happy Hour is consistently good here..
Their appetizers always come hot, and they always check on you to make sure you have everything you need even when it's a packed house.. love it here !!

My first review was from March of 2018 and things have only changed for the better in Oct of 2019 as if that could be possible!!!!

This place is a hidden secret.
Awesome lobster mac & cheese, hope you like lobster!!!!
Delicious more like our of this world German Potato Salad- one of my favorites.
Bacon is killer- I don't like bacon but at this place it is amazing and worth every bite- taste is savory and sweet. Genius!!!!!
The staff makes you feel like an old time friend and are so welcoming. 
I didn't have there philly cheese steak or there burger, but they both looked amazingly delicious!!

Recommend this place to anyone.

Oh not to mention they even have dog treats...which our two dogs give 4-paws up!!!!
Had Crêpe,parfaits here. Coffee au lait is a must try for Mew Orleans. My friends had omelet, French toast. The foods are good. The waitress had a good attitude.
The quantity was huge for the price, food was just ok. I have not tried much just few veg dishes. But you can always explore this place.

I seldom get to go out to eat but my son and his wife sent me a gift certificate for my birthday. One of the options was Outback so we ordered a to go steak dinner. It was the worst steak I have ever eaten, so dry I had to wash it down with water. My husband's was the same. The potato was fine but the salad wasn't even cold. In addition, I ordered by phone hours ahead of time but had to wait 15 minutes in the parking lot while others who arrived later got their food. I was SO disappointed!
Been sitting at the front of the drive thru window for 15 mins now. Only one in line, employees are just sitting inside doing nothing, this is an actual joke

Been a while since I have been here, Not a whole lot has changed.  All I ordered was a small coffee, It was not hot.  
Sat at a dirty table, Watched three other people clean their own table.  The staff was plenty, all chatting with each other behind the counter.  No thanks, To many great places to go In Cool Springs.  Looks like this place could use a change in management.

Went to the Mill for brunch with the family. They have many different options of breakfast dishes. Usually the food is over the top and amazing. This particular time food came out Luke warm & service was mediocre. Everyone has an off day. I would recommend the mill for the cocktails and brunch dishes !

I absolutely love this place. I find myself going to Nectar over and over again! As a native Californian I'm a bit of a Mexican food snob and nectar always hits the spot. I also love the coffee and juices. And our go to brunch spot. My only complaint is the margaritas  need to be stronger but they are delicious. Definitely a family friendly spot but worthy of a date night. If your reading this I'm probably at Nectar!

Worst Chinese food I've ever had. Egg roll was chewy, rice tasted like old oil, the general tso chicken tasted absolutely disgusting, nothing like what it should. Only good thing was the 2 pieces of brocolli.never again

We went the first week it opened and thought the veal dish was pretty good. Not a big crowd yet, so I'm guessing that's why we had a decent experience. Last night was a true disappointment. Aside from our good waiter Luigi, the kitchen was behind close to two hours and the food still came out cold. and not good. As Tampa locals/Italians we knew about four other tables that were dining and forewarned us when we arrived. I'm surprise that the owner who has a successful restaurant in North Tampa can't provide the quality food and service that people expect. Hope they get it together or they won't last....first impressions  are always so important!

The staff of Fogo Indy really needs to improve the way they treat patrons...

Fogo de Chao is one of my favorite restaurants and I've been to a number of branches (NYC, Boston, Orlando, Miami, Jacksonville and Chicago). I have been the most times to the branch here in Indianapolis (4x in 4 months, that's how I like the restaurant) and I have to say, of all the branches I have been to, the Indy branch is the most (no, THE ONLY) branch that does not seem to like their customers. 

The food at Fogo Indy is terrific! My review of the quality, taste and variety of food is 5 stars.

It is the service needs much improvement. One incident was during my birthday and I came with my wife. The restaurant knew it was my birthday as I wrote in my reservation when I made it. The waitress(not sure if this is the proper way to call her) must've been having a bad day because she never seemed to smile, and she sounded annoyed that I could not choose a wine from the list right away. During that same night, I had asked for some water from the same waitress twice, she answered the second time "could you wait!" This was in November 2018. I let it slip because people have their bad days. 

One embarrassing experience I had at Fogo Indy happened about a month later, toward the end of December (after Christmas and before New Year's eve so it is not that busy). I and a co-worker were entertaining a future colleague for work and thought we'd introduce him to a very good restaurant, before we sat down, I

Nothing came out hot. Coffee cups were gross, you could see the stir marks at the bottom of them, chips all around. Manager said "they need to be bleached" no ma'am you need new cups. Wish we could have had a better experience but couldn't even eat our meals.

This place is probably the most underrated Chinese restaurant in all of Philly I think. They're known for their speciality fish pot, which is a giant metal pot that has different variety of soup bases, veggies you select, some konnyaku jelly noodles, and seasonal entire fish like talapia, cat fish, striped base or even sometimes frog. I've been here several times and even the one in Flushing ny so they've been branching out but I think the Philly one is the best still. Surprisingly though the other dishes to me are just as good if not better than the fish. I've had the sliced pork on a stick with cucumber(fantastic dipping sauce), the beef shank and braised bamboo, chicken and hot longs(super flavorful and spicy), tomato soup and sliced fish, eggplants, tofu and preserved egg, cabbage dishes and more. Nothing we've tried really has been bad. Even their free grass jelly in the end is legendary, don't think I've ever had such amazing grass jelly before. They specialize in Szechuan food but really it's more like modern Chinese food. Even my friends from China say some of these dishes are something you won't find in typical restaurants and I agree, it's definitely a more trendy and upscale place. I think most Philly and Americans might overlook this place due to its name and all the fish dishes but in reality any dishes you have here are really great. Plus the portions are massive, the 2 of us can never finish our dishes and always have to bring home takeout. We even spend extra

Loved this place! Great location, a variety of desirable options from the food and drink menu, our service was polite, our food came in a timely manner, and our food was fresh and tasty definitely prepared and cooked to order. Why not give them a 5 star? Teddy's By the Sea is everything you could ask for.
Great food, just like my mother makes!! Very authentic and the staff was super friendly.
Worst place ever... people who work there have the worst attitude ever and so slow in drive thru.

Okay I was going to go for a one-star this time but I just have to say I know they are busy. AYCE crab legs and prime rib... what's not to like?

I was actually a little underwhelmed by this place at first. The decor is average and maybe a bit worn but not uninviting. The restroom seemed clean. The layout is a bit cramped but not prohibitive.

As for the buffet itself, the cold section, IMO, is a bit too large. Lots of fruits and salad, which is nice but I don't typically go to buffets for fruit and salad. But I guess it's nice if you go with someone who doesn't care as much about crab and meats.

Speaking of meats, prime rib is not your only option. You can also get sausage (there's cabbage a couple steps away) and ribs. The ribs were a bit tough but the sausage was pretty good but I think it's pretty hard to screw up sausage. The prime rib was pretty decent. I've had better and I've had worse. With the au jus and horseradish (no horseradish sauce that I saw, unfortunately), it was one of the better ones I've had, esp. for being on a buffet. They also had chicken on a stick and wings which were decent but nothing to write home about.

The first crab legs I got were horrible. They looked old and were brown or black. I was quite disappointed and unimpressed. You don't get to pick, really, which clusters you get (at least in the time of covid). I should've waited for the fresh ones but being my first time, wasn't sure what to expect. My next clusters, however, looked much better. They were actually orange and hot but a bit briny. Every subsequent serving was similarly
Great service with an excellent waitress.  Food was served promptly and with a smile. We will eat there again.
